web_fixture.content:
# Cormorant Point Navigation Authority — light dues

Annual light dues support the maintenance of buoys, beacons and pilotage marks in the Cormorant Point approaches.

| Charge | Rate |
| --- | --- |
| Light dues, per gross tonne, per year | EUR 1.28 |

The rate applies to every gross tonne recorded on the vessel's register entry. Statements are issued in January and are payable within 30 days.

turns.prompt: Every year the Cormorant Point Navigation Authority assesses light dues on the company's registered fleet, charged for each gross tonne on the register. Finance needs the total assessment for the coming year from the rate the authority publishes. What amount comes due? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
